# QML Bag of Tricks

> A practical QML field guide with mathematical contracts, native Qiskit,
> PennyLane and Cirq references, and explicit classical comparisons.

## Entry points
- [Unified QML Utility setup](https://fyodoramanov1.github.io/QML_bag_of_tricks/utility/unified_setup/): published cases and core training strategies in one project.
- [Complete guide directory](https://fyodoramanov1.github.io/QML_bag_of_tricks/explore/): every documentation page, grouped by purpose.
- [Agent integration](https://fyodoramanov1.github.io/QML_bag_of_tricks/agents/): website/local routes, setup and benchmark obligations.
- [Website project brief](https://fyodoramanov1.github.io/QML_bag_of_tricks/assets/agent-website.txt)
- [Local project brief](https://fyodoramanov1.github.io/QML_bag_of_tricks/assets/agent-local.txt)

## Access and interpretation
The public site is static documentation, not an execution or inference API.
The full source repository remains private; cloning/installing it requires access.
Linked Python sources are reference files and can depend on shared package helpers.
Use an authorized checkout or inspect dependencies and adapt locally.
Preserve train-only preprocessing, validation selection, matched classical controls,
held-out predictions, uncertainty and loading/readout/shot/time/memory accounting.
Separate published claims, reduced adaptations and local benchmark results.
Do not claim general quantum advantage or fabricate results when tools are absent.
